title: Open-source release
description: Readiness for publishing a repository or package as open source: license, dependency licenses, secrets, security policy, contribution guide, reproducible build, documentation and package metadata.
advisory: Engineering checklist. License compatibility and export-control questions need review by someone qualified; nothing here is legal advice.

questions.text: Will this release publish a package to a registry (npm, PyPI, …)?
Does the release ship prebuilt binaries?
Does the software process personal or sensitive data?

criteria.title: A license is chosen and present
criteria.expected: LICENSE file at the root names an OSI-approved license chosen by the copyright holder; package metadata uses the same SPDX identifier.

verification.method: Human review of LICENSE and package metadata.

task.title: Choose and add a license
task.description: The copyright holder chooses a license; add LICENSE and matching SPDX identifiers.

criteria.title: Dependency licenses are compatible
criteria.expected: Every runtime dependency's license is known and compatible with the chosen license; the audit output is kept.

verification.method: Automated license audit in CI plus review of exceptions.

task.title: Audit dependency licenses
task.description: Run the dependency license audit; resolve unknown or incompatible licenses.

criteria.title: No secrets or private data in the repository
criteria.expected: A secret scan of the full history finds no credentials, keys or private data.

verification.method: Secret scan over tracked files and history.

task.title: Scan the repository for secrets
task.description: Run a secret scan over tracked files and history; rotate anything found.

criteria.title: Security policy published
criteria.expected: SECURITY.md explains how to report vulnerabilities privately and what is supported.

task.title: Write SECURITY.md
task.description: Document private vulnerability reporting and supported versions.

criteria.title: Data handling documented
criteria.expected: Documentation states what data is stored, where, and how to delete it.

task.title: Document data handling
task.description: Describe storage locations, retention and deletion.

criteria.title: Contribution guide
criteria.expected: CONTRIBUTING.md explains setup, checks to run and the review process.

task.title: Write CONTRIBUTING.md
task.description: Explain setup, required checks and the review process.

criteria.title: Clean checkout builds and tests pass
criteria.expected: A fresh clone installs with a frozen lockfile, builds and passes tests in CI.

verification.method: CI run on a clean checkout.

task.title: Verify a clean-checkout build in CI
task.description: Run install, build and tests from a fresh clone in CI.

criteria.title: Binaries are built in CI from a tagged revision
criteria.expected: Release binaries are produced by CI from a tag, with checksums published.

task.title: Build release binaries in CI
task.description: Produce binaries from a tag in CI and publish checksums.

criteria.title: Quickstart works as written
criteria.expected: A person following the README/quickstart on a clean machine reaches a working result.

verification.method: Manual walkthrough on a clean machine.

task.title: Walk through the quickstart on a clean machine
task.description: Follow the documented steps exactly and fix any gap.

criteria.title: Limitations documented
criteria.expected: Known limitations and unsupported cases are listed honestly.

task.title: Document limitations
task.description: List known limitations and unsupported cases.

criteria.title: Package metadata complete
criteria.expected: Name availability checked; name, version, license, repository, description and files list are correct; a dry-run pack contains only intended files.

task.title: Check package metadata and contents
task.description: Check name availability, metadata and a dry-run pack's file list.
